item.title: How the Claude Code team thinks about verification
item.description:
📝 How end-to-end, property and differential tests let coding agents verify their work with evidence, and what the Claude Code team does to keep its verifiers honest. If your tests are slow, the agent will do fewer tests across batches which can make pinpointing issues difficult. Property tests look at the edge cases that people tend to miss, which is where agents often fail.
🔗 Read more: https://claude.dev/blog/how-the-claude-code-team-thinks-about-verification/
